description: Accepted Overview facts, equipment and summary frames (REQ-004; C12, C13, C14, C15; G04; V12) delivered through the shared owners SummaryFacts (wrapping, no carousel), OverviewFacts / EquipmentSummary / SummaryMetric (src/ui/refinements/overview.tsx) and the metric grid's card fill (shell.css, foreground-echo.css), adopted by Review's Overview, Session Detail's Overview and the completed Summary on the real /review, /history/:id and /summary routes (JOURNEY-004), with the accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=overview (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d). Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-004 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/summary-facts.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
